category: DeFi data API (TVL, prices, yields, stablecoins, fees)

free_tier.stated: Free API at api.llama.fi: no key, 31 endpoints, standard rate limit (number not published)
free_tier.notes: The API plan is USD 300 a month with 1,000 requests a minute and 1M calls a month; the Free API and the API plan are separate services. A keyless TVL call answered HTTP 200.

egress.terms: not metered; no quota is stated for the Free API

interface_detail: GET https://api.llama.fi/... with no key; the API plan uses https://pro-api.llama.fi/KEY/...
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; JavaScript and Python SDKs and an OpenAPI document are published
chaining: Keyless TVL, token prices and yield pools for DeFi; it pairs with CoinPaprika for market-wide prices.

limits.value: standard rate limit on the Free API, number not published; the API plan is 1,000 requests per minute

limits_note: Bulk path: CSV downloads of 34 datasets are for Pro and API subscribers only; the Free API serves JSON per endpoint. Storage terms: unverified, no page read states one.
binding_note: Only a request rate applies, and its size is unpublished.

identity_cost.detail: The Free API needs no key and no account: the docs say so and a keyless call answered HTTP 200.

reliability_note: The standard limit has no published number; a 402 from api.llama.fi means the endpoint needs the paid API.
confidence_note: Terms are read from the vendor docs and a keyless probe answered 200; the Free API rate was not measured.
